findings.evidence: #41 Top Stories for RelayKit states it is “materially broader than the browser relay-discovery client covered in April,” but the supplied snapshot contains only #38–#40 plus the #41 draft and selection ledger—no April newsletter file to independently verify that earlier coverage.
findings.recommendation: Treat RelayKit continuity as verified only against #38–#40 in this review; if April coverage must be audited, add that immutable issue to the snapshot before publish.

summary: Compared the draft Nostr Compass #41 (2026-09-23-newsletter.md) against the three immediately preceding published issues #38 (2026-09-02), #39 (2026-09-09), and #40 (2026-09-16), using section headings, cited release tags, merged PR URLs, and signed-event links in the supplied snapshot only. Repeated projects (Amethyst, Marmot/MDK, Grain, Amber, pakstr, Dart NDK, nostream, Zap Cooking, Conduit, Divine Mobile, Mostro, Nostr Mail Client, Nail, nostr-wot-extension) each anchor to a new primary source not used as the main hook in the prior three issues—chiefly v1.16.0, v0.10.4, v0.8.0-rc4, v6.6.5, v0.24.0, v0.10.0-dev.5, PRs #741/#779, #746/#744, #503, #9246/#9293, #971, v0.16.0, v0.2.2, and v0.8.0–v0.8.3. Marmot group moderation PR #423 is correctly reframed from #40’s open proposal to a merged status transition. Deep dives NIP-30 and NIP-71 do not repeat prior deep-dive headings (NIP-18/25, NIP-21/27, NIP-23/92). Limitations: pre-#38 Compass history (e.g., April RelayKit) is out of scope; #38 is truncated; draft is still draft:true; live URL contents were not re-fetched.
